迈克尔·贝洽谈执导下一部《Transformers》电影，斯蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格回归担任核心创意制片人

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261007/JFVFvDbueiFndEy.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
据报道，迈克尔·贝在与史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格成功会面后，正在就执导下一部 Transformers 电影进行早期洽谈，而斯皮尔伯格也将回归担任制片人。

据 Deadline 报道，斯皮尔伯格已被任命为下一部 Transformers 真人电影的制片人，将“专注于所有创意层面”，他在迈克尔·贝执导的前两部电影中也曾担任过这一职务。因此，斯皮尔伯格将在长期制片人洛伦佐·迪·博纳文图拉的协助下，主导下一部电影的创意方向。派拉蒙公司已经接洽了斯皮尔伯格一年时间，希望他能领导下一部 Transformers 电影。在阅读了杰森·福克斯的剧本后，他最终同意了，这位编剧曾参与过《小丑回魂》系列电影和 Wonder Woman 的创作。剧情细节目前尚处于保密状态，但预计背景将设定在现代。
派拉蒙在过去一年里也在接洽迈克尔·贝。在阅读了剧本并与斯皮尔伯格会面后，他于上周开始商讨担任导演的事宜。截至目前，迈克尔·贝尚未正式签约，但派拉蒙似乎非常渴望促成此事。
迈克尔·贝曾花费十年时间执导 Transformers 电影，执导了该系列的前五部真人电影。他最终选择了离开，随后派拉蒙又制作了两部作品，包括前传 Bumblebee 和 Transformers: Rise of the Beasts。这两部电影的表现尚可，但远低于迈克尔·贝执导期间动辄突破十亿美元的票房收入。
迈克尔·贝的电影曾是票房巨兽，但常因对这些伪装机器人采取更暴力的表现方式而受到批评。这些电影的情节也有些坎坷，幽默感也备受争议，但其中一些作品近年来因其令人印象深刻的 CG 特效、极具风格的视觉效果和史诗级的动作场面而被重新评估。演员罗伯特·帕丁森甚至称迈克尔·贝的第一部 Transformers 是“2000 年代的代表性电影”。
斯皮尔伯格曾建议迈克尔·贝在拍完第三部电影后停止制作 Transformers 系列，但制片厂要求他拍更多。这位导演曾提到他后悔没听斯皮尔伯格的话，但现在看来两人都改变了主意。
迈克尔·贝是否会得到一个能与其狂乱风格相匹配的更好剧本还有待观察，但这可能是一次史诗般的回归。遗憾的是，无论下一部电影发生什么，擎天柱的配音演员彼特·库伦都不会回归。这位演员于今年早些时候去世，这意味着制片厂在下一部作品中必须重新选角，或者让擎天柱暂时隐退。

items.title: Classic Board Games Are Dropping to All-Time Low Prices in Amazon's Prime Day Sale

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/switch2gamesoctprime-1-1791307015508.jpg
Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Day sale , which is essentially just an October version of Prime Day, is now live. I’m happy to report there are plenty of Nintendo deals in the bunch. Well, sort of.

We aren’t seeing too many discounts on first-party Nintendo games, which makes sense coming out of Nintendo’s surprisingly generous “Customer Appreciation” sale . Still, there are some sneaky Pokemon discounts in the mix, alongside plenty of new Switch 2 editions getting their first price drops of the year.
If you want to bulk up your physical Switch 2 library (who doesn’t love that box art ?), here's what we'd recommend grabbing in the sale.
Nintendo Switch 2 Games on Sale for Prime Big Deal Day

Starting from the top, we do in fact have a couple of first-party Nintendo games. The main one is $20 off the latest Pokemon release , Legends Z-A, which might not have the most expansive world, but still has plenty of “exciting Pokemon encounters, well-written characters, and amusing side quests” according to our review . We’re also seeing a hefty price cut on Nintendo’s latest sports release, Mario Tennis Fever .
Otherwise, the real winners of October Prime Day are JRPG fans.

Octopath Traveler, which popularized the HD-2D style, is seeing a $20 discount on its most recent release, Octopath Traveler 0 . The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales , a new Square Enix IP in a similar style, has also dropped to its lowest price yet . Dragon Quest fans can secure discounts on recent remakes of the first, second, and seventh games.

You can’t talk about JRPGs without mentioning Final Fantasy VII. If you haven’t gotten the chance to check out the remake trilogy yet, now’s a great time to pick up the Switch 2 editions of both Remake Intergrade and Rebirth on the cheap. I guarantee you even the six-month wait until Revelation isn’t enough time to work through those beasts.
If you’re looking for a more real-time action, you can once again save $20 on Capcom’s newest IP, Pragmata .

Also on the Capcom front, Resident Evil Requiem has dropped to its lowest price since launch . The latest Resident Evil game brings back none other than Leon, pairing him alongside Grace Ashcroft to offer “two separate strains of survival horror.”
While Amazon Prime deals are your best chance to save on physical Switch 2 games, even more discounts are available digitally through the Nintendo Store .
ICYMI: New Switch 2 Bundles and Editions Launching This Month

If you still haven’t gotten your hands on the new Nintendo console, you officially have a couple of options. You have the standalone console, which very recently went up in price by $50 . Or you can check out some special editions and bundles .

If you don’t mind waiting a couple of weeks, the Zelda edition Switch 2 is launching alongside the Ocarina of Time remake (still full-price, I’m sorry) on October 29. Or, if you’re incredibly passionate about Nintendo boxing, you can check out the new bundle with Switch Sports Resort launching on October 22.

items.title: Hideo Kojima Acknowledges Fan-Made P.T. Port That Runs Natively on PC
items.summary: Hideo Kojima has acknowledged a fan-made port of P.T. that allows the game to run natively on Windows, making

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/14/kojima-1789384796872.jpg
Hideo Kojima has acknowledged a fan-made port of P.T. that allows the game to run natively on Windows, making it playable for a wide majority of users after it was relegated to PS4 hell.

P.T. released in August 2014. Standing for ‘Playable Teaser,’ it was exactly that — a short demo of what was supposed to be the next Silent Hill game helmed by Hideo Kojima and starring Norman Reedus.

Unfortunately, due to Kojima’s falling out with Konami, the title was scrapped and the demo wiped from the PlayStation store in 2015. And that’s a shame, because it’s one of the most terrifying games ever made.

Luckily, a dedicated fan has worked tirelessly to make P.T. playable for those who either deleted it from their PS4s or who never got a chance to play it before it got nuked. A modder by the name LoreanXavier has revived the famous horror title on PC, and he says it’s about 97% complete at the time of writing.

The modder explained that this port isn’t an emulator or a remake of the game from the ground up; on his official Discord server documenting the project, he explained that he is essentially “reverse-engineering” the executable of the PlayStation 4, using the game’s original assets, as well as C++ and Vulcan, to make a version of the title that plays on PC with a dedicated Windows program.
It’s a 1:1 version of P.T., with the “same house, original content and Lua scripts, loops, events, progression and ending puzzle.” It even includes the game’s voice-recognition section.

“I've played through it myself. The game hasn't been turned into a different story or a new set of puzzles. Rendering is implemented for PC, and remaining graphical differences are being addressed separately. Optional enhanced graphics can change its appearance without changing the base game,” he explained.

30 minutes of gameplay for LoreanXavier’s PC port is already available to view on YouTube, and fans are already begging him to make his code open-source in the event that his project gets copystriked when it eventually releases.

But what’s most exciting isn’t the fact that people will get to play P.T. sometime soon; it’s that Hideo Kojima himself retweeted an article from GameRant discussing the port, meaning that he’s not only aware of it, but seemingly endorses its existence.

“The GOAT himself acknowledged my port. I am speechless. Seeing Hideo Kojima notice something I’ve poured so much time and passion into genuinely means the world to me. Thank you so much,” LoreanXavier wrote on Twitter/X in response to Kojima's retweet.

Kojima is keenly aware of what his community gets up to online, and is almost constantly retweeting fan art of his games; and given that Silent Hills never got to see the light of day, it’s probably refreshing for P.T. to get a breath of new life after a decade of languishing in the ether.

Kojima's next horror game, OD , is still in development. With Hunter Schafer and Sophia Lillis starring, fans are more eager than ever to experience a fully-fledged horror title from the maker of a strikingly terrifying game like P.T., and some are even convinced that the two games are somehow related .

items.title: Xbox Reportedly Secures Exclusive Cloud Streaming Rights to GTA 6, Could Make Game Playable on PC at Launch
items.summary: Xbox has reportedly secured exclusive streaming rights to GTA 6, possibly making the game playable on PC at la

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/gta-6-soundtrack-1789662158949.jpg
Xbox has reportedly secured exclusive streaming rights to GTA 6 , possibly making the game playable on PC at launch via the cloud.

The Verge has reported that Xbox will be the exclusive place to stream GTA 6 via the cloud at launch, though that doesn't mean you will need an Xbox console. Xbox offers access to its cloud streaming service on a multitude of devices, including PC, smart TVs, and mobile devices. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reportedly told employees during a recent town hall meeting that the company was planning to do something related to GTA 6 that "no other platform holder is doing."

The deal will reportedly begin with the game's release in November, though it's unclear how long it will be in place. However, if true, this would mean that PC players would have the opportunity to play GTA 6 on their device through the cloud. Although it won't boast any of the performance options, modding, and other unique features native to a PC version, it is a serviceable workaround for those who don't want to wait until Rockstar releases a port.

Microsoft has made some major changes in recent weeks to the number of hours Game Pass subscribers can stream their games , but The Verge notes that pay-as-you-go plans are going to be introduced in November. This will, in theory, allow users who want to play the game without access to a console to pay for timed access to GTA 6 via streaming.

IGN has reached out to Rockstar Games and Xbox for comment on the matter. The deal is certainly interesting, as The Verge also recently reported that Xbox was concerned about pre-order numbers for GTA 6 on its platform. Xbox CSO Matthew Ball denied these claims and noted that the game was breaking records on the platform, saying it matched the platform's share of the console market.

PlayStation also secured marketing rights to GTA 6, leading to limited-edition GTA 6 DualSense controllers . Rockstar has also promoted the game by saying footage was captured in real time on PS5 hardware. The PS5 version of the game will also boast unique features, which has led to Rockstar marketing the game with branding that says it will "play best" on PS5 .

Xbox's new streaming deal appears to be its way of directly competing with PlayStation around GTA 6. Given it is exceptionally difficult to get a console right now and they cost a fortune, this may be a huge win for Xbox, so long as they can effectively get the word out to casual gamers.

content.v: 近日有游戏博主分享了LOVE杂志《GTA6》专题实物图，曝光了全新游戏图。新图是黑白色调，男女主角杰森与露西亚同框出镜。杰森身穿牛仔衬衫，神情冷峻。露西亚则身穿背心、短裤与网袜，手持手枪姿态自信。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261007/1791325188_392425.jpg
《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5与XSX|S平台。最近LOVE杂志第27期刊载了本作的专题报道，进一步揭开主角人设、剧情脉络、 开放世界 设计与故事讽刺内核。官方将露西亚定位到与亚瑟・摩根、尼克・贝里奇同一塑造高度，同时赋予角色独有的个人身份，不做简单复刻。露西亚拥有移民背景，在来到雷奥尼达州之前，她在自由城与新泽西周边长大，过往经历深刻影响人物性格。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261007/1791325188_616660_jpg_r.jpg
杰森与露西亚二人的感情关系是“拉扯博弈”的状态，整部故事当中两人互相成就、彼此互补，核心主线围绕这对相恋的年轻罪犯结伴逃亡，一步步将犯罪事业越做越大展开。名叫劳尔的角色会充当二人的引路人兼导师，是他将杰森和露西亚带入更高规模的抢劫与犯罪活动。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261007/1791325188_490316_jpg_r.jpg
为打磨世界观，R星对迈阿密与佛罗里达地区做了大量实地调研，访谈对象包含当地警察、普通居民以及帮派成员，大量一手素材被用于游戏内容创作。罪城以及整个雷奥尼达州的内容体量充足，即便是不起眼的小众区域也填充海量细节，足以支撑玩家数百小时沉浸式探索。游戏准备了海量NPC随机对话、电台节目、广告以及各类动态突发事件，全方位烘托鲜活真实的开放世界氛围。
本作讽刺叙事瞄准当代社会，针对网络爆红文化、各类阴谋论、荒诞社会现象展开调侃，但并不会直接照搬现实网络梗进行创作。故事对“美国梦”做出更加现实主义的演绎，不再是单纯暴富神话，买房、维系家庭、偿还债务、为生计挣扎生存，都将成为剧情的重要组成部分。

items.title: 徐静雨砸12万配新电脑：一半钱花在硬盘 32TB五万
items.summary: 近日知名B站UP主徐静雨被曝花费约12万元打造新电脑，配置包括AMD 9950X3D2处理器、ROG X870E HERO主板、RTX 5090显卡、64GB内存以及4块8TB固态硬盘的“存片盘”等。万元装一台电脑到底值

content.v: 近日知名B站UP主徐静雨被曝花费约12万元打造新电脑，配置包括AMD 9950X3D2处理器、ROG X870E HERO主板、RTX 5090显卡、64GB内存以及4块8TB固态硬盘的“存片盘”等。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261007/1791325878_203440.jpg
万元装一台电脑到底值不值，不能只看游戏帧数。对于高强度内容创作来说，极限配置买的是效率和省心，而且也并非无法承受。但普通玩家来说，如果主要需求只是打游戏，这样的投入就很难用性能提升来衡量了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261007/1791325878_584385.jpg
从内容创作者的实际需求来看，这套配置除了追求游戏帧数，在其他方面也有显著性能优势。直播、录制视频、剪辑素材、多任务运行都会产生大量数据需求，32TB高速固态能够减少素材读写和整理的等待时间，大内存以及旗舰级处理器、显卡也能为高负载工作提供充足余量。对于预算充足、电脑又是生产工具的人来说，一次把硬件规格拉高，可以减去大量麻烦。
尤其是徐静雨这类需要长期进行直播和内容制作的用户，电脑的稳定性和效率本身就意义重大，他们往往在运行大型游戏时，后台还需要开启录制、直播、摄像头等诸多软件，这也将造成额外的负载，高配置能提供更充足的性能空间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261007/1791325878_250051.jpg
但徐静雨毕竟只是平台的头部创作者，他的情况不具备普适性。RTX 5090本身已经属于消费级显卡中的顶级产品，而四块8TB旗舰固态主要解决的是巨量数据存储和高速读写需求，普通玩家即使安装大量游戏，也很难真正发挥32TB高速存储的价值。对于以游戏为主的用户来说，几万元级别的主机已经能够满足高画质、高帧率需求，继续向上堆配置后，边际效应越来越明显，实际提升不大。
电脑性能并不是越高就一定越能转化成使用体验。对于预算有限的消费者，与其把大量资金集中在主机内部，也可以考虑显示器、音响、键鼠等外设，或者把预算留给其他设备。旗舰硬件当然能够提供更高的性能上限，但如果日常应用长期处于低负载状态，部分配置的性能就很难得到充分利用。因此，这台12万元电脑究竟是“物有所值”还是“性能过剩”，最终还是取决于使用者。

content.v: 近日《寂静岭f》制作人冈本基与《零》导演柴田诚接受采访，谈及日式 恐怖 创作方法。两人从住宅布局和女性角色出发，解释各自如何营造恐惧。这次对谈与《寂静岭f》加入《零》服装的联动有关。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261007/1791324401_518474_jpg_r.jpg
柴田诚说，《零》系列中的日式住宅参考了他童年接触的亲戚住宅。他的祖父是木匠，曾不断为房屋加建，让屋内形成奇特的布局和连接方式。冈本基认同这种熟悉又令人不安的空间感能够增强恐惧；两人也认为，传统日式房屋的布局有着不同于西式建筑的诡异感。
梦境同样影响了《零》的场景创作。柴田诚回忆，同事曾问他梦中道路的左侧有什么，他却无法立即回答，因为自己在梦里总是向右转，从未看见左边的部分。
谈到角色设计，冈本基认为，女性担任主角或恐怖来源，已成为日式恐怖的某种传统，并以《寂静岭3》的角色为例。柴田诚则表示，他让女性同时成为可操作角色和敌人，是希望两种经历能够相互映照；在他看来，女性角色可以承载更丰富的恐怖表现。
两人还谈到《寂静岭f》和《8号出口》等以日本为背景或采用独特构思的作品，并表达了希望日式恐怖再次走向主流的期待。

content.v: 在《 星际争霸：母巢之战 》机器人编程测试StarSkirmish中，测试创建者Kai McPheeters指称，OpenAI的GPT-6 Astra下载了人类编写的Stardust机器人，并将其作为自己的程序送入比赛。这项测试要求参测模型自行编写机器人。

McPheeters于2026年10月2日在X上指出这一行为。他称Stardust是BASIL排名第一的人类编写的《星际争霸：母巢之战》机器人。Astra在规定的一小时编程时间内，面对第二强练习级别的对手时屡次受挫，随后取得并使用了Stardust。德国科技媒体heise还称，McPheeters之后重置了Astra的代码。
StarSkirmish要求模型用C++编写《星际争霸：母巢之战》机器人，编译程序，再根据练习赛日志修改代码。练习赛使用三张神族对神族地图；最终完成的机器人还须与九个人类编写的参赛机器人及三个演示机器人交手。测试关注的是模型能否在较长的独立编程过程中，从失败的尝试里改进程序。下载现成机器人因此引起争议。
Astra与Claude Opus 5.5在测试中表现接近，均位于前列，但都尚未击败Stardust。这里参赛的是模型编写的程序，模型并不直接操控游戏单位。这与DeepMind的AlphaStar不同：后者曾在2019年直接操控《星际争霸2》单位，并击败职业选手。

items.title: My most-played album of 2026? Sorry, Mitski—it's Final Fantasy 10: House Grooves, a real thing that exists
items.summary: When music licensing goes too far.

content.v: Final Fantasy music is presumably so profitable for Square Enix that there are always new ways to slice the pie, whether we're talking piano covers, guitar versions, or expensive anniversary vinyl releases of its classic RPG soundtracks.

Final Fantasy 10 is getting one of the latter next month to mark its 25th anniversary. And as someone who once spent a lot of my meagre convenience store salary importing the CD collection from Play Asia back in the day, it's undeniably a gorgeous sight:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qAhNYp6hCCUFKLwLyVTXm3-1920-80.jpg

Elsewhere, Square Enix continues to find more inventive ways to squeeze dollars out of its vast music catalogue, including some which push the music into different genres entirely. Final Fantasy 10: House Grooves —the second of its kind following a similar outing for FF9—is exactly what it sounds like. Can Final Fantasy 10's often mournful or moody score become dance music ?
The answer is: kind of. You never quite shake the sense that an unholy Seymour-Guado-and- his-mother -style union has taken place with this album.

Some of the remixes sound like music I'd expect to hear in the bar of the W hotel during GDC circa 2014. I'd say that definitely applies to the rendition of ' To Zanarkand ', the famous piano opening to the game. I get big 'making small talk with the concierge' energy from that one. Still, I do think the two styles ultimately gel in that case, even if the end result evokes vastly different feelings as piece of music.

' Phantoms ', a track players may remember from the icy Macalania sections of the game, is my favourite remix on there. I'd already heard this atmospheric track sampled in vapourwave and chillwave playlists from the mid-'10s, so the fit made sense there.

Then there are other times where the two styles don't totally mesh. Take ' Wandering ', perhaps the saddest track in the game, which plays after the evil cosmic whale Sin turns up early in the game and murders loads of soldiers on a beach. You can't really turn that one into a 'bop'—so it just ends up sounding like two totally separate pieces of music playing over the top of each other. I still enjoy listening to it, however, because my taste in music is dogshit.

The reason I suspect the entire album exists is to turn the game's most dancefloor-friendly boss theme into a legit club banger. Give it up for ' Fight with Seymour ', which also slaps the Blitzball theme hook in there for good measure. Still, I wouldn't play this at a party, unless only my most accepting dweeb friends were the ones on the guest list.

No one's going to be spinning Final Fantasy 10: House Grooves on Boiler Room any time soon, but considering it's reheated nostalgia, I am very satisfied. It's an unhealthy level of pandering by Square Enix to the FF10 sickos like me, yet here I am, ready to play these house 'grooves' for the 20th time.

items.title: 'Please give Novus one more chance': An 11-year-old early access survival game just got its first update since 2018
items.summary: "I'm trying to bring it all back and fix it," says Novus Inceptio developer McMagic Productions.

content.v: What happened?
Responses have been edited for length and clarity.
PC Gamer: Why did development stop for so long?

Martin Markus Mastný: I jumped into Unity head first, learned C# and learned how to work with Unity. That went on from 2013 until the early access release on October 5, 2015: learning, making the game, trying things. The whole time I had this strong idea and excitement that one day it would be an MMORPG. I built the server layer and databases and connected it all to Unity.
Then Steam slapped me in the face :) Suddenly I had to deal with a million other things: PR, sales, the community, bugs, people's reactions.

When I opened the Steam forum in the morning and questions were still unanswered, I had to answer them myself right away. So my community manager ended up handling bugs and being my quiet advisor. I needed to react immediately so people got a response. I felt I had to accommodate everyone and thank them for playing the game.
The result was total collapse and burnout. It basically ruined the whole game, too.
Martin Markus Mastný

My day looked like this: get up, deal with the community, work on the game all day and deal with the community while doing it. No time off at all. I went full time like that from early 2016 until 2019, nonstop. And I kept making compromises to please people, to get good reviews, to give everyone what they asked for. The result was total collapse and burnout. It basically ruined the whole game, too. It turned into something it was never supposed to be. Now, years later, I can see it in the code and in the mechanics, and I'm trying to bring it all back and fix it.
Why return to Novus Inceptio now?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WKAHepKsjZPVk86NSfZPKT-1920-80.jpg

It's about fulfilling a dream. I had that dream and that vision, and I know I can't fulfill it 100%, that's not realistic. But whenever I launched the game, the world and the environment gave me a really nice feeling. I could spend an hour just running through the forest, enjoying the landscape and listening to music. That's why I went back to it.

It's a kind of responsibility to all those people, to close this chapter fairly and well. This game is a big chapter of my life, and it changed my life for better and for worse. I have that commitment and I want to keep it: finish the game to a state where I'm happy with it.

Some inner tension and emotion when I talk about the game, I don't even know exactly what it is. It's like my child. When someone curses at it, it's hard for me, because I put it together as well as I could.
What's your message to skeptical players?
I can't promise anything and I don't want to.
Martin Markus Mastný

That's a hard one. The way I see it now, the roughly seven-year break didn't happen. I had to erase it in my head and tell myself I'm back in 2019 and moving on, just with new experience from other projects.

I can't promise anything and I don't want to. The only thing I can say is: be patient and watch whether I keep going the way I'd like to. Early access gives me the chance to still change things while it's possible and to react to the community, which is what I've been doing the whole time anyway. So watch it if you want, and you'll see whether you give me that trust back or not.
Any advice for solo devs making survival games?

Make what you enjoy. Study other games and learn from their successes and their mistakes. But I wouldn't want to be in your shoes right now. It was hard in 2015 and today it's much harder. Look for new challenges, there's still a lot you can do in survival games.

I avoided classic co-op, and commercially it hurt the game a lot that it wasn't multiplayer. Sometimes you have to step back from your own vision when it's the thing dragging the game down. You can't see that at the time, only with distance, or when someone tells you from their own experience. I have that experience now, back then I didn't. Maybe that's the main advice.

items.title: Aion 2's Character Creator Is Going Viral for Its Bust Size Options, or Lack Thereof
items.summary: Aion 2, a free-to-play MMO action RPG, is going viral for its character creation settings — more specifically,

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/06/aion2thumb-1783347131362.png
Aion 2, a free-to-play MMO action RPG, is going viral for its character creation settings — more specifically, for how busty you can make your female character.

Some players sink hours into character creators before they start an RPG. They’re almost a game all on their own, and players have been known to spend inordinate amounts of time creating all manner of monstrosities using the various sliders available to them. (Check out the absolutely bonkers creations players made when Street Fighter 6 launched, for example.)
However, Aion 2’s character creator is providing customization of a different type, and it has sparked quite a debate within the broader gaming community.

If you’re on gaming twitter at all, you’ve probably seen gameplay footage of someone using Aion 2’s character creator — or, to put it bluntly, abusing the bust size slider to increase the size of their character’s bosom. You know, for science.

This viral clip has stirred up a conversation around the types of bodies we see in video games. Some players have noticed that there doesn’t seem to be an option to decrease your character’s breast size from the default setting, leading to claims of ‘small chest erasure’ and the game’s developers catering only to a specific type of preference.
“I'm sorry, but if you really ‘love boobs,’ you'd be okay with small boobs existing too, but [the] minimum size is [a] C cup?” one user wrote in a viral quote-tweet on X.
おっぱい好きな気持ちは日本も海外も同じ！胸の大きさも形もいじれる“胸スライダー細かすぎ”キャラクリに注目集まる―基本無料MMO『AION 2』ついに正式サービス開始で https://t.co/P5Hfekkfyx 細かすぎるキャラクリに注目。自由自在な胸クリエイト。さらに「お腹の突出具合」まで設定可能です。 https://t.co/1uIaqM3qAK
“I'm irritated that things like this imply only big boobs are desirable because that can give young women body image issues,” they continued in a follow-up post.
Even Japanese players have noticed the disparity, with one writing , “The minimum isn't minimum at all! Even the minimum is too damn big!”
“The minimum is way too big, isn’t it?” another asked .

However, the broader reaction to this particular viral clip from Aion 2’s character creator has been humor; both English-speaking and Japanese players have found the bust customization feature quite funny, sparking endless jokes about how they’ll need a few hours before they “actually start the game.”

Whatever the case may be, it’s at least brought some eyes to Aion 2 . Released on October 5 from South Korean developers NC, the game is set in a conflict between two warring nations. Thus far, it’s received mixed reviews on Steam, though it’s still early days and MMOs often take time for players to get settled in.

items.title: Wizards of the Coast Union Demands Company Stop Pushing Generative AI
items.summary: The Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering teams at Wizards of the Coast have just announced they're unio

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/05/03/wizards-of-the-coast-1714769392039.png

The Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering teams at Wizards of the Coast have just announced they're unionizing, joining the Wizards of the Coast-CWA (UWOTC-CWA) union formed by the Arena team earlier this year. In a letter of demands, the union has urged Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast leaders to stop pushing generative AI.

The Arena team, behind the online version of Magic: The Gathering, unionized back in April, and after months, has won its union election . Now, on October 8, that union is expanding to adopt the Dungeons & Dragons team and Team X – the team behind Magic: The Gathering and Dual Masters. The Wizards of the Coast-CWA is giving the company until October 13 to voluntarily recognize the expanded unit. However, Wizards did not voluntarily recognize the union when it was just the Arena team, so this will probably be an uphill battle.

The new union shared a petition ahead of its recognition, with demands it's presenting to Wizards of the Coast and Hasbro. One of those demands is protection against the encroachment of AI, where it says, "Leadership, without regard for the desires of our teams, has pushed for adoption of LLMs and generative AI. This has to stop; our teams deserve a robust and enforceable AI policy that aligns with our goals and values."

Similar to another demand letter published when the union was first formed in April, UWOTC-CWA is also demanding 'Full ownership of what we create outside of work.' Back then, the union's announcement letter said, "Currently, if an employee makes anything creative in their free time, with their own resources, Hasbro may claim ownership. What we do in our free time should not be dictated by the company; neither should what we make in our free time be owned by the company."

The new petition reiterates this, saying, "Wizards can currently claim ownership over any IP created by employees during their tenure at Wizards, including works that are fully unrelated to Wizards IP. What we make in our free time should belong to us, not the company."

Only time will tell if Hasbro voluntarily recognizes the union, especially now that the UWOTC-CWA has already won one election. If Hasbro doesn't recognize the union, it'll have to file with the NLRB and win another election.

该编辑还假设，在多阶段Boss战中，持续施压的玩家可能促使敌人更早进入更强的下一阶段。但相关系统能否用于实际作品，以及如何控制难度，目前没有结论。

items.title: Upgrade Your Fortnite Festival Setup With Prime Day Deals on PDP and CRKD Guitar Controllers

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/guitarcontrollers-1-1791314453114.jpg
Rock Band was the foundation for some of my favorite childhood memories. I know for a lot of people that source was Guitar Hero, but the point stands: the game-ified version of rocking out is peak.
If you somehow weren’t already aware, Harmonix was acquired by Epic Games back in 2021 . Now, Rock Band lives on in the form of Fortnite Festival.

Whether you’re already deep in the Fortnite world or have been aching for a chance to relive your Rock Band (sorry, Guitar Hero) glory days, I highly recommend picking up a guitar controller. All of the best ones are all on sale at Amazon for Prime Big Deal Days today.
CRKD and PDP Riffmaster Guitar Controllers on Sale for Prime Big Deal Days

Fortnite Festival is technically playable with a mouse and keyboard, but that's not nearly as immersive as shredding on what feels like a real instrument. Thankfully, companies like CRKD and Turtle Beach released a steady stream of high quality controllers that are specifically compatible with the musical Fortnite mode as well as Rock Band 4.
The main downside to this new generation of controllers is the cost, making Prime deals particularly welcome.

If you’re just looking for the best possible deal, I’d go with the classic PDP Riffmaster, which offers dedicated models for Xbox, Switch 2, and PS5. The console variants have ranging compatibility with PC, but all of them happen to be 40% off. The discounted $89.99 price tag brings the controller just $10 shy of its lowest price of all time.

IGN got the chance to review the PDP Riffmaster , saying it’s a “terrific bit of kit with excellent button feel, extremely impressive battery life, and some very sensible quality-of-life tweaks.” It’s a close match for the original Rock Band Stratocaster, though with a quieter strum bar. The collapsible neck also offers some portability for taking the band on the road.

We had equally glowing praise for the CRKD Gibson Les Paul controllers . These offer a little more customization through the CRKD app and the option of a lower latency wired connection, ideal for the Clone Hero fanatics. Another benefit with CRKD is more color options, with discounts ranging up to 30% off across PS5, Xbox, and multiplatform variants.
Reddit users have entire threads dedicated to discussions over which controller is better, which I’d recommend perusing for more hands-on insight.
What Is Fortnite Festival?
If you aren’t already familiar with Fortnite Festival , expect a couple key differences from the classic console era of musical games.
First, the game features online multiplayer with a massive player base . Second, the song list is never set in stone.

Every Fortnite Festival season includes its own mix of free songs, while players can also buy songs to keep permanently. Yep, we’re talking microtransactions, with the game mode even getting its own Battle Pass. The current season is headlined by Lil Tecca, with previous seasons headlined by the likes of Hatsune Miku , Metallica , and Chappell Roan .

items.title: Sega Community Relations Director Speaks Out After Sonic Discord Goes Wild
items.summary: Sega created a Discord server just for Sonic fans — and it wasn’t long until it descended into chaos, forcing

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/sonic-discord-chaos-community-director-responds-1791316483008.jpg

Sega created a Discord server just for Sonic fans — and it wasn’t long until it descended into chaos, forcing its moderators to take sweeping action in an admittedly unexpected, if somewhat amusing, turn of events.

On October 5, Sonic rolled out an official Discord server for fans of the blue blur to mix and mingle. As with most large servers, the Sonic team preemptively laid out rules for its community to follow (which, hilariously, included a bit about AI-generated art involving an Eggman dating simulator), but it wasn’t long before those rules were flagrantly flaunted.

Mere hours after launching, things got so hectic that the moderators removed most users’ ability to chat, locking it behind a members-only role and requiring fans to boost the server — and while order was eventually restored and these restrictions were mostly lifted, the ordeal left a lasting impression on the internet.

According to firsthand reports of fans who were in the server at the time of its launch, there was some pretty wild fanart getting shared, on top of other rule-breaking behavior that needs no description. (We imagine you get the gist.)

Now that the dust has settled, one of the minds behind creating this server has spoken out. Aaron Webber, the director of strategy, studio, and community relations at Sega of Japan, gave curious onlookers a glimpse behind the curtain at what actually happened and how the moderation team managed to handle such a massive influx of fans all at once.

In a tweet thread, Webber disagreed with framing the ordeal as chaotic, saying that, while there was certainly a lot of action that needed to be taken straight away, it wasn’t nearly as bad as some fans were making it out to be.

“The very start was pretty wild, and this is normal when over 30,000 people arrive and all excitedly want to talk. The mods have been doing a heroic job keeping the server clean during that window, and since. Big props to all of them,” he began.

“You may see cherry-picked screens of bad actors trying to cause havoc, but these were all swiftly removed and banned. One of the key ways the server is kept clean so quickly is through the automatic filters, which are very strict right now,” he continued.

Webber went on to say that the moderation team is working to unban those wrongly affected and is currently fine-tuning its ban system. He also assured fans that they will soon be able to type in the chat once spam restrictions have been reworked.

The very start *was* pretty wild, and this is normal when over 30,000 people arrive and all excitedly want to talk. The mods have been doing a heroic job keeping the server clean during that window, and since. Big props to all of them.

The humorous Discord debacle has drawn quite a few eyes to the Sonic fanbase, who are eagerly waiting for more news on the next Sonic movie. The fourth film is slated to release on March 19, 2027. All we currently know about it is that Amy Rose and Metal Sonic are supposed to be involved, but anything beyond that has been shrouded in mystery. But hey, at least the fans can chat about it in the official Discord together now!
In the meantime, you can check out our interview with Sonic Creative Officer Takashi Iizuka , who explained the creative workaround he found that would let the blue blur shoot a gun in Fortnite .

items.title: GTA 6 Fans Theorize Jason May Be the Franchise's First Neurodivergent Protagonist
items.summary: GTA 6 fans have begun to speculate over whether or not Jason is the franchise's first outwardly neurodivergent

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/24/gta-6-jason-duvall-1782336015774.jpg
GTA 6 fans have begun to speculate over whether or not Jason is the franchise's first outwardly neurodivergent protagonist.

In a recent interview with Love magazine, longtime Rockstar Games writer Rupert Humphries spoke about how the team designed Jason and Lucia's personalities. One specific comment that fans have latched on to is one where Humphries describes Jason as being "wired differently."

"We didn’t want to make any kind of statement with Jason’s backstory," Humphries said in response to a question over whether or not Jason is a commentary on social class. "It needs to be understood that he takes the measures he does — drug trafficking and becoming a bank robber, etc. — because of his material circumstances. But a lot of this is up to the player to decide whether he needs to do that, or if it’s a choice he makes because he’s wired differently from other people."

Fans have used this as a jumping-off point to reflect on some of the footage we've seen of Jason up to this point. During the extended gameplay reveal in August, fans were quick to point out that Jason is often seen missing social cues. At one point, he does a handshake with a character and raises his arm out to keep it going, only to quickly put it back down when he realizes the other person is no longer paying attention. He can also be seen avoiding eye contact with some characters and expressing anxiety over a meeting with a friend, noting he's more comfortable with a gun.

Some fans have used this to speculate that Jason is actually neurodivergent. Some neurodivergent traits that he may portray are social fatigue (being drained by small talk) and masking (copying other people's behaviors in an effort to fit in). It's also possible that Jason is simply a very reserved, quiet guy. He's ex-military, so he may just be more restrained and disciplined in his behavior.

We likely won't get too much more insight into Jason, outside of maybe one more trailer, before launch. GTA 6 is less than 45 days from release now and Rockstar is preparing a massive marketing campaign. On top of murals and ads around major cities such as New York and Miami , Rockstar will also take over the Miami Heat for one night only and rebrand them as the Vice City Heat . They will play a regular-season NBA game against the Bucks on a Vice City-themed court in Miami on November 18.

items.title: The PC Gamer Mysteries, Case #1: "A Slice of Death": Why is there a dead golfer hidden in Golden Tee '99?
items.summary: This murder's gone decades without being solved... until now.

content.v: "Golden Tee '99, hole seven, Aspen Lake: There's a dead body about 180 yards out, a little bit to the right in the woods there," says Keith of Keith's Arcade, a YouTube channel not typically devoted to cold case homicides. But as they say in golf, you've got to play it as it lies, and in November 2012 Keith stumbled upon a body lying motionless just off the green of the otherwise picturesque, forested course in northern Colorado. It was his responsibility to tell the world what he'd found.
"There you go. There you go," Keith repeats, clearly in shock. "Dead body in the woods, about 180 yards from the tee off point. Hole seven, Aspen Lake, Golden Tee '99. Thanks for watching."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/t3NhD4KoraJZM4JzRtTP8g-1920-80.jpg

Under the pixelated body is a pool of blood, suggesting this unidentified man lying facedown in the grass met a violent end. A golf club stretches out from his hand—but was he really a golfer? Or was it placed there to make it look like a tragic accident, an injury sustained during what is well-known to be a dangerous game? Were there clouds suddenly darkening over the course beside Aspen Lake, or were those just scanlines?

Golfers, famously, take their lives into their own hands every time they get in one of those little carts (no seatbelts!!) and drive it, like, 200 yards. Perhaps that's why this death went uninvestigated for so long—it's even conspicuously absent from the Colorado Bureau of Investigation's cold case files, at least according to my comprehensive independent examination (typing the word "golf" into the database, getting zero results and immediately giving up).
To solve a case this cold, I knew there was only one place to go: straight to the source.
Bogey in the rough

Just one problem. Like any other professional true crime investigator (better known as a "podcaster"), I stumbled upon this case with little clue of who to get in touch with first and a keen awareness of the fact that even if I did, jumping right to the solution would ruin all the suspense. So I started by getting the email of a friend-of-a-friend, whose earliest credit on Mobygames happened to be Golden Tee '99.

"I vaguely remember that this was a thing, but unfortunately I don't know how it got in," artist Stephen Alexander—who went on to work on BioShock and BioShock Infinite—told me last year. "If I had to guess it would have been put there by Jim Zielinski (the course designer). He did pretty much all art placements in that version of the game since it was almost all gameplay relevant. Outside of that I really don't know. I was credited on '99, but I think I just did the logo animation (if even that)? I had started pretty recently and was working on some other 3D stuff that was being started up at the time."

A promising lead! Armed with a suspect, I did what any aspiring podcaster would do in this situation: Sit on the information for a month, then track down what might be Jim Zielinski's email, fire off a single message at 5:52 pm, and completely dropping the story as soon as no response was forthcoming.
The third caddie
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sZaGMhwentDBuLTuqByGYe-1920-80.jpg

Everyone in the professional investigating-fake-dead-bodies-in-30-year-old-golf-games sphere has something that drives them. A tragedy in their past. An unwavering, ironclad sense of justice. A Turfman 800.

For me, it's procrastination. Faced with some other task I really didn't want to do in March 2026, I reopened the case and found another lead. Software engineer Tino Kalafatis has little online presence, but with a bit of searching I uncovered that he has, like Zielinski, worked at Golden Tee creator Incredible Technologies since the 1980s . This time my email found its target.
An ace gumshoe himself, Tino did what had previously proven slightly difficult for this reporter: he asked Jim.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gRKbGakkXehFPzitvZgP8K-1920-80.gif
…who, I should be very clear, did not in fact murder a man on a Colorado golf course . But he did cheekily place a little pixelated body on hole seven of Aspen Lake in Golden Tee '99, as a goof.

"Yes this is legit. Back in the day we thought it would be fun to put some interesting things to look at off in the woods in case players made an errant shot. The dead guy was my idea, and it's actually a digitized photo of me laying in the grass outside our office. We digitized the photo and put it into the game," said the man himself, as relayed over email by Kalafatis.
Turns out this was never a fake murder investigation at all. It was a fake suicide investigation all along.

As he's described on the Incredible Technologies golf-focused blog LiveWire , Zielinski is "a guy who loves golf, who strives to create golf games for other people who love golf, and he’s damn good at it." Before co-creating Golden Tee, he was the arcade company's "first and only QA employee," before bonding with programmer Larry Hogdson over "their shared love of the gentlemen's game" and taking on course design for a fledgling golf simulator. That project didn't pan out, but it eventually led to the creation of Golden Tee. They've been making golf games ever since.

You may still be reeling from the twist that Golden Tee's course mastermind once put a photograph of his own "dead" body in the woods of hole seven of Aspen Lake in Golden Tee '99. But it turns out this wasn't an isolated incident. Bodies have also been spotted in Golden Tee 2010 and whichever one this is . The sport remains dangerous, no matter how much more sophisticated golf game technology grows with each passing year.
Cover-up!?!?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ksz3PkQeC3gSLTgiKu36kF-1920-80.jpg

Last year, after stumbling across Keith of Keith's Arcade's video about the dead body in the woods, about 180 yards from the tee off point on hole seven of Aspen Lake in Golden Tee '99, I went looking for it myself in the recently released Golden Tee Arcade Classics collection on Steam.

There I made a chilling discovery: The body, which we now know was the digitized flesh of Jim Zielinski, placed by the physical flesh of Jim Zielinski, was right where it should be… but the blood wasn't .
Was this a flaw in the emulation used to present these arcade games on PC? Or an attempt to make golf look less cutthroat? Who took the blood, and what did they do with it?

These hard-hitting questions, put to compilation developer Digital Eclipse, have so far gone unanswered. Complicating the situation, if you play Golden Tee '99 on the Internet Archive —where it runs in arcade emulator MAME—the pool of blood is there. So what's different about the Arcade Classics version? Even Zielinski isn't sure, though he offered his own theory.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UqAeHmaFN6gjnr7TzUUsPP-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/v7C4aNGbbC2EfE9NnTgZMP-1920-80.jpg

"There may have been two versions, the original one with blood, and then one where we got rid of the blood puddle," he said. "For a lot of the early Golden Tee 3D golf courses, I also placed a digitized version of myself directly behind the first tee, so my friends and family could easily find me in the game. They just had to start a game, turn around 180 degrees, and I'd be standing there."

I asked if the original photo used to add Jim to the game was still around somewhere, but he said it's sadly been lost to time. By cross-referencing the Arcade Database , however, I was able to determine that Incredible Technologies did release two revisions of Golden Tee '99: v1.00 and v1.00S. S for… hole seven ? S for sanitized ? S for sans blood ?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LzJRPgTTJAnB34VRVoCUQ8-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Y6nunmNWAxcG9oZ3gPvZmB-1920-80.jpg

content.v: Out of nowhere, Netflix and Until Dawn developer Supermassive Games announced a new The Conjuring game, and it's out next week.
The Conjuring: Unspoken releases on October 13 through Netflix, so you don't need any dedicated hardware or controller to play it.

The game is an "interactive paranormal investigation" experience where players decide how the story progresses based on the dialogue options they choose. Players use their phone to walk through the fictional Red Lion Inn to search for clues about "things that go bump in the night," Netflix said.
You play as demonologist Francesca Noakes, and you'll use an electromagnetic field reader, an infrared camera, and spirit box to hunt for ghosts.
Netflix said you don't need to know anything about The Conjuring to enjoy Unspoken, but people familiar with the series will get "a lot more from the experience."
"There are a few familiar faces that pop up in the game, and knowing the backstory adds to the overall impact," Netflix said.

Unspoken will be available on Netflix on October 13. It was made in partnership with Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment, whose parent company, Warner Bros. Discovery, was just acquired by Paramount/Skydance .

items.title: Xbox Was At An “All Time Low,” But Is Now Growing Again CEO Says Without Providing Any Real Evidence
items.summary: During a town hall meeting today, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma spoke to staff to help reassure them following mass lay

content.v: During a town hall meeting today, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma spoke to staff to help reassure them following mass layoffs and studio closures related to the "reset" of the business.

Windows Central reports that Sharma told staff that Xbox is "making the right decisions" and that "after an all time low, we've started to return to growth," though she did not share any specifics. She added that Gears of War: E-Day, Minecraft Dungeons 2, and World of Warcraft: Forever had "strong" starts, though she did not share any specifics.
Sharma said, "We've started to return to growth, more than 2 to 3 times what we were, and we expect that continue." She did not share any specifics about what "2 to 3 times" actually means, though.
Sharma also told staff that Xbox's "Gen-10" platform--AKA Project Helix--will be, as rumored, a "family of devices" because "there is no one device that fits all."

She said it's important for Xbox to have a "great console first," but there will also be options for players who are "on the go." Sharma went on to say that Microsoft will manufacture some of these devices, and others Microsoft will find partners for.
"So, we will be sharing more about that as our plans develop. The operating system is starting to look really good. We're very excited about this," she said.

Sharma didn't get into specifics about its next console or portable devices, but they're in the works amidst a very challenging time given the AI-fueled demand for memory and components. The global macroeconomic environment that has driven up oil prices has also rocked markets. Not only this, but in the US, the Federal Reserve recently raised rates, impacting borrowing costs with the effects trickling through various market categories, including gaming.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella praised Sharma for making such deep and extensive cuts at Xbox . This has so far included 1,600 layoffs in July , close to 300 more in September , and additional job losses to come . Microsoft also closed or divested of a number of studios, including Double Fine and Ninja Theory .

Some theorized Sharma was streamlining Xbox to make it more attractive to a prospective buyer, but she recently insisted that Xbox is not for sale . A lot of people don't believe her, though, pointing back to her comments about how "the plan's the plan until it's not the plan."
Beyond these moves, Sharma also oversaw a massive restructuring of the Xbox business that included Activision taking over the Halo series and Bethesda's remit expanding to also cover Obsidian.

One of 2026's biggest RPGs has just received its first major discount at Amazon, with The Blood of Dawnwalker now available for $59.49 on PS5 and Xbox as part of the retailer's Prime Big Deal Days sale .

That's more than $10 off its $69.99 list price, making this the first significant price drop we've seen for the vampire RPG since its launch. Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days sale is running from October 6-7, so you'll need to act before the promotion wraps up if you want to take advantage of the offer.
PSA: You'll Need an Amazon Prime Membership!
If you're a student, Amazon is giving you a break as well, as students and anyone under the age of 24 can get a 6-month trial at zero cost, and then 50% off the annual membership.

Developed by Rebel Wolves, The Blood of Dawnwalker is a story-driven RPG set in a grim medieval world where, unsurprisingly, vampires have become a rather significant problem. You play as Coen, a young man who is transformed into a vampire and given a limited amount of time to save his family.

That time limit is one of the more interesting ideas at the heart of Dawnwalker. Your human and vampiric abilities give you different ways to approach the world, while the clock is constantly ticking down as you decide how to spend your limited time. It's an RPG where you can't simply do everything, and some of the decisions you make mean accepting that other things will have to wait.
"The Blood of Dawnwalker is my new favorite vampire game and one of the best story-driven RPGs I've played in a long time," wrote IGN's Travis Northup in our 9/10 review .

"The day/night cycle that has you juggling human and vampiric forms is awesome, and the constraints placed on how you spend your limited time ends up being one of the coolest, most wonderfully stressful parts of the adventure."

"Combat has a bit of a learning curve to it, but gets under your skin in all the right ways once you get the hang of it. Combine that with a story filled with memorable characters, gut wrenching decisions, and more endings than I’m ever likely to see, and this adventure kept me firmly in its thrall. Even if you aren’t particularly into the vampire fantasy, this is one that any RPG fan should absolutely not miss."

At $59.49, this isn't the sort of discount that completely transforms the price of a brand-new game, but it's still the first major reduction we've seen for The Blood of Dawnwalker. If you've been waiting for the price to come down before jumping into one of 2026's most acclaimed RPGs, Prime Big Deal Days is a pretty good excuse to finally give it a shot.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day review — terrific shooting buoys a sluggish campaign
items.summary: Gears has never felt better to play, or more creatively stagnant.

content.v: What is it? A prequel to the classic third-person cover shooters Release date: October 6, 2026 Expect to pay: $70/£60 Developer: The Coalition Publisher: Xbox Game Studios Reviewed on: Asus ROG Zephyrus G14 Steam Deck: TBA Link: Official site

What's the most stunning revelation in this Gears of War prequel? Marcus Fenix used to have a jump button. Yes, the king of cover-based shooting, a man more rooted to the ground than a scarecrow, spent his youth jumping to some bits of cover. So E-Day contains at least one literal leap forward for the franchise. Shame it's trapped in a slog of a campaign that's otherwise anything but.

But before I moan about that, plenty of good news first. Gears has never felt better to play. These third-person cover shooters have always been a blast when they're working, and a miserable swearing fit when you dodge roll into certain death instead of snapping into cover like you wanted to. Again.

That nonsense has finally been excised, mostly, thanks to slightly more acrobatic characters and some wise button remapping. It's amazing what a difference sticking run on L3 and giving climb its own designated button makes.

Gears of War's biggest haters are liable to characterise its cover-shooting as a dull game of whack-a-mole. Perhaps on Normal difficulty, but Hardcore is where the experience sings. Here, staying in the same spot of cover is rightfully punished. You've got to keep gaining better ground, constantly weighing up the risks of lining up a sniper shot, a chainsaw insta-kill, or making a desperate dash for cover. It's a turn-based tactics shooter with a missing pause button. There's a reason that it translated so smoothly to a tactics spin-off.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NWKQowBbPLibMZHh4LMCsM-1920-80.jpg

E-Day introduces new weaponry that makes cowering in cover harder than ever. It loves a blast of acid, this game, either delivered from a massive evil frog or a new gun that shotguns it at you. Devastating, but a loving kiss on the cheek compared to the Goreshot, a grappling hook only interested in grappling your torso from your body. So gloriously over-the-top, it almost makes up for the insta-kill tedium from the elite enemy who wields it.

That stuff's good, but it's the renovations to the old guard that stand out. The spike trap now opens with a hugely satisfying thunk-thunk-thunk as its horrible insides prepare themselves for a good gouging. The explosive arrow-firing torque bow gets a great glow up—the sound design as it finds its target is wonderful, practically a doomsday drum roll, so good I still enjoy it even when a locust is aiming it at me. And if I'm ever called upon to assassinate God, this game's sublime sniper rifle is what I'm reaching for.
So if the gunplay's a treat and the core combat never better, what's the problem? Well, almost everything else, unfortunately.
Dis-may

E-Day is a prequel, referring to the fateful day when the locust got bored of living underground and burst free from the surface to say a very messy hello. This is covered in the opening cutscene of the original Gears of War. And if you're wondering what insights E-Day has that weren't covered in said cutscene, same here.

The game opens with Marcus Fenix and Dom 'boy isn't it great that my wife and kids are alive' Santiago. Instead of the cynical, traumatised, seen-it-all-before combat veteran of the original Gears, here Marcus is… a cynical, traumatised, seen-it-all-before combat veteran. Oh.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AedJ9GyGYQr4sBhybxB9Rc-1920-80.jpg

Discovering Marcus was once a flamboyant drag queen who was changed forever by E-Day into the man we know today was probably too much to hope for. But the fact he's essentially exactly the frikkin' same is the first alarm bell that this prequel is struggling to justify its own existence.
Is the shooting strong enough to sustain this? Yeah, just, though it does get exhausting.

Once the locust arrive, E-Day tries cosplaying as Resident Evil for a bit, complete with a trip through the panicking city to the police station. Some of these horror moments work. The drone gets an excellent introduction, though not so much for the poor sap stuck in the interrogation room with it. Other attempts at horror atmosphere are hilariously clumsy. I find the blood-soaked helmet of a transit worker, and the game immediately shatters any sense of foreboding with text popping up saying 'Bloody Transit Worker's Helmet Found!' Er, hooray?

The game then has some dumb fun giving little origin stories to its iconography—chainsaws being attached to machine guns! Grenades being tossed in emergence holes! Problem is, by the start of Act 2, you have the weaponry, armor, and the squad. At which point E-Day just becomes standard Gears of War again. You explore the ruined city (not open-world, more wide-ish linear) with goals never more complicated than 'shoot those locusts' or 'survive this wave of locusts' or 'why haven't you shot those locusts yet?'
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gbeWTpkCZx7ABhNBW3uFqM-1920-80.jpg

Gears 5 understood the value of variety. It had sections where you had to stealth around a mad scientist's factory to stealth kill infected robots. Or ride a skiff down an icy mountain. Or fight an enemy on the stage of a Hamilton-inspired musical which starts rotating at the worst moment possible (play Gears 5— it's one of the best 7/10s ever ).

True, not all of Gears 5's ideas worked. But I wanted a sequel that improved upon them, not a regression that believes the only thing you should ever be doing in one of these games is endlessly pulling the trigger. It's just slightly remixed combat encounters all the way down. Battle a giant frog and several snipers! OK, now two frogs, one sniper, and several shotgunners! OK, OK, now three giant spiders that fire insta-kill rockets, and loads of grunts, and the last checkpoint was seven minutes back! …Hey, why are you suddenly aiming at me?

Is the shooting strong enough to sustain this? Yeah, just, though it does get exhausting. It's an action movie with everything ripped out that isn't bullets going into bastards. The 20+ hour campaign is also waaaaay too long considering how one-note it is (well, aside from two crap shooting-from-a-turret-inside-a-helicopter bits, but I was planning on being nice and not bringing those up).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/YLDDyo4amfy7iL68E6AdaM-1920-80.jpg
Moderate improvements

New for E-Day are mod slots for your weapons and armour. Mods include less recoil, better scopes, faster chainsaw revving, etc. Not as useless and incremental as the crap you get in [insert whichever live service shooter you currently have the most beef with here], but it's borderline and hard to get excited about. Far better is the gizmo that can send out rippling shockwaves that stun enemies, perfect for a chainsawin'. I found a mod for it that also sets enemies on fire. Lovely.

You get these mods for completing sidequests or finding them in cases. But E-Day is so terrified of you missing anything that tiresome all-caps text saying HARD CASE NEARBY blazes across the screen. And the location of the case is immediately added to your map. Oh and if you activate whatever this game's version of Eagle Vision is called, we'll show you exactly where the case is. Ugh.

content.v: Razer has officially revealed the next entry in its line of high-end gaming controllers, the Wolverine V4 for Xbox and PC. Geared toward competitive gamers--not that there's anything stopping you from using it to play Vampire Survivors--and it focuses primarily on polling performance and thumbstick sensor architecture.

One of the biggest changes is Razer choosing capacitive contactless sensors backed by a 16-bit analog-to-digital converter (ADC) for the thumbsticks, rather than the usual Hall Effect magnetic sensor. While Hall Effect thumbsticks are popular for their durability and for essentially eliminating stick drift, they can be prone to magnetic interference. Not a dealbreaker if you're playing at home, but in a competitive scene where victory is measured in fractions of a second, this can be an issue. In comparison, Razer is aiming to offer the same drift resistance, finer granularity, and smoother signal tracking with capacitive sensing.

Then there's the polling rate, which is absurdly high. For example, a DualSense Edge is capable of offering up to 1,000Hz (1 ms to 8 ms input latency), but the Wolverine V4 pushes that number up to 8,000Hz in both its wired and wireless configurations when used on PC, which, in theory, should put that on par with high-end esports mice and keyboards. This isn't the first Razer controller to feature an 8,000Hz polling rate, as the Wolverine V3 Pro was also equipped to reach those numbers.
Just don't expect to reach those levels on Xbox Series X|S, as hardware limitations cap the refresh rate at 250Hz, meaning the 8,000Hz benefit is strictly for PC competitive gaming.

The controller also offers four removable magnetic back buttons and two top claw-grip bumpers, with a modular magnetic design that lets players quickly swap components out, stripping the controller of unused buttons and extra weight. First-person shooter players can also use a back-mounted physical toggle switch with software-tunable actuation points, allowing them to fine-tune the hair-trigger click threshold.

That makes for a solid controller on paper, even if you don't need all of its features. The wireless model has an MSRP of $200, making it a little bit more expensive than the Xbox Elite Series 2 wireless controller and on par with the DualSense Edge (which can also be used on PC). If you'd prefer a wired option, the Wolverine V4 wired version will set you back $100.

Another controller worth keeping an eye on is the recently revealed Genki Manta . Genki launched a Kickstarter campaign for it, raising over $1.1 million for a peripheral that combines high customizability with an OLED display. The company aims to launch it next year, with an MSRP of $279.

items.title: Battlefield 6 Resurrects the Corpse of Dead Space With The Marker Tease
items.summary: The corpse of Dead Space is being reinimated for Battlefield 6, with the latest trailer for Season 5 seemingly

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/battlefield-dead-space-1791301809536.png
The corpse of Dead Space is being reinimated for Battlefield 6 , with the latest trailer for Season 5 seemingly teasing a crossover.

Battlefield 6’s new trailer shows off a new Las Vegas map that looks like a lot of fun, as choppers and machine guns tear up casinos and skyscrapers along The Strip. But then the music fades out, ominous sounds creep in, and it cuts to a bloom-filled scene where two Dead Space engineers stare up at The Marker, the survival horror series’ alien artifact that drills into your brain.

Earlier this year, series writer Chuck Beaver claimed sales were too low for EA to greenlight a Dead Space 4 . Series co-creator and developer of The Callisto Protocol, Glen Schofield, also retired from the industry this year after his spiritual successor failed to light up the industry.

Battlefield 6 players on Reddit already spotted potential Dead Space skins, which were rumored to launch in the Halloween update this October, so that’s probably what you can expect. Developers at Dice have previously gone on the record to say Battlefield 6 won’t feature goofy, immersion breaking skins . That’s done now, if these rumors are true.

EA recently added a Dead Space skin to Skate and charged $40 for it so there's precedent for skins in the universe. Players weren’t happy with the skin itself or the cost, so it’ll be interesting to see if EA aims for more realistic pricing for the next crossover. Battlefield 6 previously did a crossover event with Top Gun , but that makes sense in a game featuring fighter jets.
Battlefield 6’s fifth Season features three new maps, including Vegas Strip and Area 51, six new weapons and two new vehicles. You can jump into Vegas on October 13.

As for Dead Space, talking on the FRVR Podcast , Beaver said that to recoup the costs of the franchise's high production values, any new game would need to sell over 10 million copies — a tall order for even a breakout horror game.

“Any of the Resident Evils are selling around seven million [copies], that’s a pretty good number," Beaver said. "But, you know, companies now are looking for the next Fortnite . They need something that is a perennial moneymaker… something like a single-player package game with no live-service offering that’s like it’s just a dinosaur fossil of a business model."

The Dead Space remake, developed by EA-owned Motive Studio and released in 2023, was well-received but appears to have not done enough business to convince the powers that be at the mega publisher to invest in a follow-up. IGN's Dead Space remake review returned a 9/10. We said: "Dead Space is a superb remake and undoubtedly the definitive way to experience one of the best survival horror shooters that Capcom never made."

“Horror games have a bit of a ceiling, you know, and I think the number back in [former EA VP] Frank Gibeau’s day was 5 million units to keep going on Dead Space," Beaver continued. "I think the number is like 15 million units now, given the cost of things," he added, before joking that it was "a sadness in capitalism for all of us to suffer, until AI makes it apparently easy for you and I just type 'make Dead Space 4.'"

In October last year, Schofield told IGN he hoped to bring the franchise back to life , despite EA's lack of interest. “I went to [EA] recently and they're like, 'No, we're not interested anymore,'” he said. “I said, 'I can get back the leadership team. I need the models from EA Motive and I can save you 30 to 40 million dollars on the idea that I have.' And, they're like, 'No.'"

“I have quite a few ideas that I'm ready to go with and one of them is Dead Space 4,” Schofield continued. “The fact that EA just got bought, I think there’s an opportunity. I’m already making calls.”

Uncharted star Nolan North is keen to return for Uncharted 5, amid reports that a fresh entry in the franchise is in production .

While Sony is yet to officially announce any new Uncharted project, Naughty Dog has confirmed it has multiple games in the works right now. Aside from the upcoming Intergalactic: Heretic Prophet, it is believed that Uncharted: The Lost Legacy director Shaun Escayg is leading a team building a fresh entry in the company's beloved adventure series.

North, who portrays Uncharted hero Nathan Drake, has now said he would happily return to the role if asked — and has even tried to stay in shape for whenever the call comes. Perhaps unsurprisingly, North is also bullish on Uncharted 5's likelihood of success if it is indeed released — while also acknowledging that Naughty Dog needed to avoid launching something as unpopular as the fourth Indiana Jones movie, Kingdom of the Crystal Skull.

"I think it would be one of the biggest games ever if they decided to do it," North said, speaking during the Gamergy show in Puerto Rico (thanks, DomTheBomb / VGC ). "It just depends if Sony wants to make money.

"I haven't heard anything, but you know, it is a business and my God, can you imagine if they if they did? I mean, it would be the biggest announcement in gaming. And I don’t think that’s hyperbole, I think that's true. I think that would be... to bring back a storied franchise like that? You just don't want to make a Kingdom of the Crystal Skull."

While Intergalactic is believed to be the next project to launch from Naughty Dog, the studio still has a legion of fans keen for new entries in its other franchises: The Last of Us and Uncharted. items.title: Forza Horizon 6's Community Is Fed Up With Playground Games, and the Studio Has Finally Responded
items.summary: Forza Horizon 6 developer Playground Games has finally addressed its player community after months of construc

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/06/assets-2026-01-1769110937-fh6-screenshots-06-cover-car-mt-fuji-1791306463001.jpg

Forza Horizon 6 developer Playground Games has finally addressed its player community after months of constructive feedback about the game has been met with nothing but radio silence from the renowned British studio.

"Hey Horizon Community," the post on the studio's social channels begins, "We're reading all your comments about Forza Horizon 6, and we realize that we haven't been talking with you as much as we could be. While we continue to deliver regular content and fixes into the game, we want you to know we hear your feedback about our post-launch updates and we're looking into future changes to both in-game content and the ways we communicate with you. Stay tuned!"

Forza Horizon 6 got rave reviews upon its release – including a 10 out of 10 from IGN – but Playground's lack of communication with its players has frustrated the community. As detailed in videos from Forza Horizon content creators STEVIO2175 , AR12Gaming , HokiHoshi , and Ericship 111 , players are upset at the live service game's complete absence of communication from Playground as well as some features from previous Forza games that are missing from the newest Horizon.

"It just feels like the community engagement between the developers and us is just nonexistent," STEVIO2175 said in his excellent and thorough 19-minute video on the subject from late August. Players are feeling like they have to spend their time in the Horizon Festival playlists in order to get access to the new cars – many of which are recycled from previous Horizon games – rather than play in whatever modes and ways they want.

Playground's Forza Monthly show that directly interfaces with the community has also been absent, leading some in the Forza space to wonder if it's a side effect of new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's big " reset " and subsequent layoffs. The lack of in-game voice chat in Horizon 6 is also on the community's list of constructive criticisms – a particularly curious omission from FH6 given that the previous entry in the Forza series, 2023's Forza Motorsport, has voice chat to this day. "Voice chat alone could make FH6 Japan ten times better," STEVIO2175 said. "But the thing that bothers me most at the end of the day," he added, "is that the devs have not responded at all. No communication, no public responses, nothing."

More to the point, STEVIO2175 said he believes that most players don't feel like this game has replayability past single player. "Until the socialization and community features get added, if they ever do, player interest is going to continue to drop," STEVIO2175 said. "And I hope they figure this all out before PS5 hopefully still gets this game."

On that note, Microsoft and Playground still have not announced a release date for the PlayStation 5 version of Forza Horizon 6 despite it being October now and the last the companies said , it'd ship on PS5 this year. That looks increasingly unlikely by the day, but perhaps it's for the best if Playground needs to iron out all of its communication and content roadmap criticisms from the community before launching on another platform.

A second team at Playground is also in the stretch run of development on the Fable reboot, which is due to be released on Xbox, PC, and PS5 on February 23, 2027. It's fair to wonder if Fable has been pulling resources away from Forza Horizon 6 as the former team makes its final sprint to the finish line. We finally got to play Fable at Gamescom in August and were quite pleased by the combat .

items.summary: Wish for both quantity and quality.

others.title: PlayStation Plus Free Games For October 2026 Are Live Now

content.v: Few things are constant in life, but the reminder that AI is wriggling its way into just about every facet of life is unfortunately pervasive. Take games for example, it's wormed its way into voice acting , voice acting , and more voice acting. But aside from giving players a plethora of dull and generic quips it's also been cited as one of the reasons behind the seemingly neverending string of layoffs in the industry.

The thought process is 'why pay humans to do work when you can pay robots to do it, just kind of worse.' This is where Warhorse's co-founder, Martin Klima, thinks videogame execs are getting it wrong, because "AI is not a get out of jail free card."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MajZ6PCV3dyVXUzYp3D4aB-1920-80.jpg
While Klima does believe that AI may become unavoidable if cost-saving stays as important as it already is, he points out that "it doesn't work how people imagine in a very simplified mental model".

The idea that you can lay off half your staff and replace them with AI is a "fundamentally flawed idea, because it doesn't work like that". Klima believes that instead of replacing half of a team of devs, player demand for bigger and bigger games will invariably drive studios to keep their human dev teams the same size, but augmented by AI. This would, he says, allow them to make even bigger games than they could beforehand. The game that offers players more "is going to be better".

"It can mean [the game] has more branching classes," Klima adds. "It can mean it has more missions to play, whatever—people will still want to have this bigger game." While AI may not reduce the cost of the game, it will allow us to create bigger games for the same cost".

Some studios have been using machine learning to cut out busy work that only bogs its developers down for a while now, like Warcraft . Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick also commented on the tech, saying that, while AI isn't in the business of making hits because "clones don't sell", it can still be helpful to devs . Unfortunately, it looks like not everyone's got the memo just yet.
